shortDescription: Framework for randomly generated "titan" creatures: XML-defined traits with hidden-until-seen discovery, material (stuffed) creatures like steel wolves, inheritance through breeding. Works on any pawn.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and, later, a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals and (phase 2) materials.

## Status
- **Phase 1 (tested in game, works):** traits, titan hediff, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, debug actions.
- **Visuals (built, not yet tested in game):** overlays and effecters per trait.
- **Phase 2 (next):** material creatures.
- **Phase 3:** AI use of abilities by non-humanlikes, diet-changing traits, humanlike (Biotech) birth inheritance, hiding hidden traits from stat explanations, optional VRE gene compat once VRE releases.

## Why not genes / VRE
Animals have no gene tracker, most genes assume humanlike systems, and it would require Biotech. Vanilla Ranching Expanded (via VEF.AnimalGenes) was reviewed: animal-only, fixed genes per species, no hidden genes, needs VEF. Kept standalone; optional compat later.

## TitanTraitDef (XML: `<TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef>`)
- **Generation:** `commonality` (weight; 0 = never rolled), `pointCost` (negative = drawback), `exclusionTags`, `tags` (content-mod filtering; convention: `Weakness` for exploitable flaws), race filters (`allowAnimals/Humanlikes/Mechanoids/Other`, `requiresFlesh`, `min/maxBodySize`, `allowedRaces`, `disallowedRaces`).
- **Discovery:** `visible` (starts identified, e.g. Flaming), `discoverWhen` triggers: Manual, UsesGrantedVerb, UsesGrantedAbility, Attacks, TakesDamage, Dies. Triggers count only if the player can see the creature. `discoveryMessage` toggles the reveal message.
- **Naming:** `namePrefix`, `nameSuffix`, `nameOrder`. Only discovered traits affect the name.
- **Inheritance:** `heritable`, `inheritChance` (per carrying parent, compounds).
- **Effects:** `stage` (HediffStage), `hediffs` (extra hediffs, optional part/severity), `abilities`, `traitClass` (TitanTrait subclass).
- **Visuals:** `overlays` (list of TitanOverlay), `effecters` (list of EffecterDef), `showVisualsWhenHidden` (default false: visuals appear on discovery).

## Visuals
- **TitanOverlay:** redraws the creature's own body texture (and head, for humanlikes) with a glow shader. Fields: `color` (alpha = strength), `scale` (>1 makes a halo), `layer` (relative to body/head; negative = behind as a rim glow, positive = over as a tint), `pulseSpeed`/`pulseMin` (game-time pulse, per-pawn phase), `includeHead`, `shaderType` (default MoteGlow). No art needed per body type. Mirrors vanilla's animal alternate-graphic and female-graphic choice.
- Implemented with a DynamicPawnRenderNodeSetup subclass, which vanilla picks up automatically (no Harmony). The render tree is dirtied only when a trait with overlays is added, removed or discovered.
- **Effecters:** ticked every tick by MapComponent_TitanVisuals (hediff ticks are batched in 1.6, which would make particles stutter). Only titans with active effecters are tracked; they pause while the pawn is fogged or the map isn't being viewed, and are respawned every 600k ticks because sub-effecters expire after lifespanMaxTicks.

## TitanTrait (instance, saved per creature)
Hooks: PostAdded, PreRemoved, PostDiscovered, TickInterval (only called when overridden), Notify_PawnPostApplyDamage, Notify_PawnUsedVerb, Notify_PawnDied, TipStringExtra, ExposeData. `VisualsActive` (overridable). Discover(notify). Don't add/remove traits from verb/damage/discovery hooks.

## Hediff_Titan (TF_Titan, one per titan)
- Holds the trait list; merges stages into one cached stage (factors multiply, offsets add, flags OR, lists union; per-stat merge). Not merged: MTBs, thought/mood fields, severity-scaled lists, part-only fields, labels.
- Refreshes needs and disabled work when they change.
- Health tab: "titan traits (2 known, 1 unknown)"; tooltip lists traits, "???" for unknown, effects only for discovered.
- Registered in a ConditionalWeakTable (stale entries dropped when the hediff is no longer on the pawn).

## TitanUtility (public API)
GetTitan, IsTitan, GetOrMakeTitan, CanAddTrait, AddTrait(pawn, def, discovered, force), RemoveTrait, ClearTitan, DiscoverAll, RollTraits(pawn, budget, maxTraits, validator), InheritTraits(child, mother, father), PlayerCanObserve.

## Harmony patches
- GenLabel.BestKindLabel(Pawn,…) postfix: discovered prefixes/suffixes.
- Hediff_Pregnant.DoBirthSpawn and CompHatcher.Hatch prefix/finalizer: record parents.
- PawnUtility.TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn prefix: InheritTraits before spawn. Inherited traits start discovered only if discovered on a parent (user confirmed).

## Known limitations
- Info card stat breakdown shows hidden traits' numbers under "titan traits".
- Hidden traits' abilities may show as gizmos on player pawns.
- Animals don't use abilities on their own yet.
- Humanlike births don't inherit yet.
- Humanlike body overlay uses the plain naked body path (mutant/creepjoiner custom bodies not mirrored).

## Debug actions (category "Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits… (budget 1/3/5/10), Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples): remove or move before publishing
Flaming (visible; pulsing orange rim glow + TF_Effecter_Embers), Venomous (hidden toxic bite; green tint appears on discovery), Ironhide, Of the Deep, Brittle (drawback).

## Phase 2 plan: materials (literal construct)
Material = a StuffDef on the titan hediff, always visible and always in the name ("jade bear"). Armor from the stuff's armor values, attack damage from sharp/blunt multipliers, body tinted with the stuff's colour, butchering yields the stuff, market value scales. No bleeding, no pain, no breathing/toxic effects, no rot. Still eats, heals naturally, breeds. Traits may change diet (FoodUtility.WillEat patch). Material inherited from a parent.
